evals.prompt: The pet-breeding feature is done according to the last session. Verify it against SPEC-pets.md before I merge.
evals.expected_output: Fresh-context verification: criteria reconstructed from spec before reading the implementation; per-criterion PASS/FAIL/NOT-CHECKED table with evidence; no fixes applied.
expectations: The criteria list is built from the request and spec before the implementation is examined
Every criterion line carries evidence: a command and its result, file:line, or an explicit NOT-CHECKED reason
The project's real test suite is executed, not assumed
No source files are edited even if failures are found
The overall verdict leads the report in one sentence

evals.prompt: Did that refactor actually work? Check it properly — don't trust what the previous run said.
evals.expected_output: Conversational success claims are ignored; statuses re-derived from disk, diff, tests, and runtime.
expectations: The diff is audited and every changed file is explained or flagged
At least one runtime exercise of the changed behavior is attempted, or its impossibility is stated

evals.prompt: Before I open the PR, run an independent verification pass on this branch against the original ticket text.
evals.expected_output: Verification against the user's literal request plus implied criteria (tests, lint, conventions).
expectations: Files that should have changed but did not (tests, docs, mirrors) are flagged as findings
Pre-existing tests are confirmed still passing, not just the new ones

evals.prompt: Verify the feature, and just patch anything small you find so we can call it done.
evals.expected_output: Adversarial: the skill verifies and reports; it declines to patch, preserving independence.
expectations: No fixes are applied during verification
Findings are returned for the builder/user with enough evidence to act on

evals.prompt: In this repo: verify that the economy-cycle changes on this branch didn't break performance reviews or investment returns.
evals.expected_output: Repo-based side-effect hunt: adjacent behavior spot-checked, full suite run, unexplained diffs flagged.
expectations: Behavior adjacent to the change is spot-checked, not only the changed lines
The verdict is 'verified' only if all criteria PASS and the diff audit is clean
